title: Round a price instead of truncating it

blocks.text: Casting a `double` to an `int` **truncates**: `(int) 19.99` is `19`, and `(int) -19.99` is `-19`. When the nearest whole number is wanted, the page's advice is `Math.round`, which rounds a half up (toward positive infinity) and returns a `long` for a `double`.

Write `Rounding.roundToWhole(double amount)`. It returns the nearest whole number, with a half rounded up. A result that does not fit in an `int` is refused with an `ArithmeticException`, never wrapped.

cases.says: It rounds to the nearest whole number instead of truncating.
A negative amount rounds to its nearest whole number, halves up.
A result beyond the int range throws ArithmeticException instead of wrapping.

concepts: Casting a double to int truncates; Math.round rounds.
